title: PowerToys often absent from system tray first thing in the morning

judgment.rationale: The issue includes a bugreport ZIP, a concrete overnight-idle scenario, and logs showing an elevated runner restart plus a captured runner-exit observation in module logs.
evidence: The reporter says PowerToys is often absent from the tray in the morning after an overnight idle period with no reboot.
The attached bugreport contains runner-log_2026-08-26.log showing an elevated restart sequence.
FancyZones logs in the same bugreport include “PowerToys runner exited.”
judgment.recommended_action: Run a maintainer-side overnight repro focused on silent runner exit while elevated.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report is actionable for local reproduction, but the current evidence is not yet specific enough for one lifecycle fix.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys sometimes disappears from the tray overnight on an elevated system install, and the attached bugreport already shows at least one runner-exit observation in module logs.
known_information: The machine stays logged in overnight and the reporter verified there was no reboot.
PowerToys is configured to run elevated and show the tray icon.
The attached bugreport contains runner logs and module logs from the affected environment.
inferences: The overnight failure is likely a lifecycle or restart-path issue in the elevated runner.
A controlled overnight repro with current logs is more useful than another generic reporter request.
issue_context.analysis: The issue is best represented as reproducible. The evidence is strong enough for a maintainer-run long-duration scenario, but still too broad for an honest fix plan.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the issue body and bugreport ZIP.
Reviewed runner-log_2026-08-26.log and confirmed an elevated restart sequence.
Reviewed FancyZones logs and confirmed a captured “PowerToys runner exited” event.

actions.label: Reproduce overnight tray disappearance
actions.note: Exercise the elevated runner lifecycle under an overnight idle scenario.

reproduce.version: PowerToys 0.101.2262 or newer current main build
prerequisites: System installation with PowerToys configured to run elevated at startup.
Tray icon enabled and FancyZones enabled so module health is obvious.
Leave the machine logged in and idle overnight without rebooting.
steps: Start PowerToys elevated and verify the tray icon is present.
Leave the machine logged in and idle overnight.
In the morning, verify whether the tray icon and FancyZones are still active.
If PowerToys has disappeared, immediately collect current runner and module logs and compare them with the attached runner-exit evidence.
reproduce.expected_result: The tray icon and modules should remain available after the overnight idle period without a silent runner exit.

design_decision.reason: Next best step is controlled reproduction.

confidence.rationale: Scenario and attached logs are concrete, but the terminating component is still not isolated.
